# A workshop checklist can become a test

People hesitate when I watch them follow the new opening sheet. They appear to think they are being assessed. Say explicitly that we are testing the sheet, and ask where it fails. If the person compensates for a missing step, write down the compensation rather than ticking the instruction as successful. [[Field methods]]: smooth performance can conceal a broken tool.
